Lepont - znaczy miło i smacznie.
Jan 2024 • Family
Lepont is an excellent restaurant just outside the center of Cat Ba. Great service that tries to do everything to make guests happy. The waiter Duong DC was particularly professional, thanks to him we had a nice time there every time. Very tasty meals, lots of choice. The location and decor make it a pleasant time to spend there. Prices similar to other restaurants. The price-quality ratio is very good. you can count on happy hour between 6 p.m. and 8 p.m.
